BusinessImpact: Creates negative length of stay and invalid inpatient performance metrics.
RecommendedRemediation: Flag and quarantine invalid date sequences before calculating LOS.

BusinessImpact: Duplicate patient identifiers can cause double-counting, incorrect patient-level aggregation, and unreliable joins.
RecommendedRemediation: Investigate duplicate identifiers, retain one canonical patient record, and quarantine unresolved conflicts.

BusinessImpact: Provider-level productivity and utilization metrics may be understated.
RecommendedRemediation: Retain null only where operationally valid; otherwise assign Unknown Provider for reporting.

BusinessImpact: Numeric lab results without units may be ambiguous and unreliable for analytical interpretation.
RecommendedRemediation: Derive the expected unit from LabTest where the mapping is deterministic.

BusinessImpact: Diagnosis-level prevalence and utilization reporting may be incomplete.
RecommendedRemediation: Map valid codes where possible; otherwise classify as Unknown/Unmapped Diagnosis.

BusinessImpact: Duplicate diagnoses can overstate diagnosis counts, condition prevalence, and diagnosis-level utilization.
RecommendedRemediation: Deduplicate identical encounter-diagnosis assignments after validating diagnosis type consistency.

BusinessImpact: Produces negative wait times and invalid operational performance metrics.
RecommendedRemediation: Flag invalid timestamp sequences and exclude those records from wait-time KPI calculations until corrected.

BusinessImpact: Incorrect units can lead to invalid comparisons and misclassification of laboratory results.
RecommendedRemediation: Standardize ResultUnit using the approved LabTest-to-unit map.

BusinessImpact: Affected encounters cannot be reliably attributed to departments or facilities.
RecommendedRemediation: Map valid department identifiers where recoverable; otherwise assign an Unknown/Unmapped department key.

BusinessImpact: Produces negative booking lead time and invalid scheduling-efficiency analysis.
RecommendedRemediation: Flag invalid records and exclude them from booking-lead time calculations.

BusinessImpact: Invalid reference ranges can produce incorrect abnormal-result classification.
RecommendedRemediation: Replace invalid ranges using approved reference values for each synthetic lab test.

BusinessImpact: Negative costs can understate total and average cost KPIs.
RecommendedRemediation: Flag invalid negative values and exclude them from financial KPIs unless a verified adjustment/credit meaning exists.

BusinessImpact: Procedure utilization and cost reporting may be incomplete.
RecommendedRemediation: Map valid procedure identifiers where possible or assign Unknown/Unmapped Procedure.

BusinessImpact: Negative procedure costs distort service-line and procedure-level cost analysis.
RecommendedRemediation: Flag and exclude invalid negative values from cost KPIs unless verified as legitimate adjustments.

BusinessImpact: Prevents reliable measurement of follow-up timing and post-discharge care.
RecommendedRemediation: Flag inconsistent records and exclude them from time-to-follow-up calculations.

BusinessImpact: Invalid birth dates produce incorrect age and age-group calculations used in population analysis.
RecommendedRemediation: Flag impossible dates and exclude them from age-derived calculations until corrected.

BusinessImpact: Inconsistent encounter categories fragment utilization metrics across dashboards.
RecommendedRemediation: Map known variants such as ER, emergency, and Out Patient to approved encounter categories.

BusinessImpact: Provider-level scheduling and capacity analysis may be incomplete.
RecommendedRemediation: Assign Unknown Provider where unresolved while preserving the appointment for department-level reporting.

BusinessImpact: Invalid status categories distort no-show, completion, cancellation, and rescheduling KPIs.
RecommendedRemediation: Standardize known variants to approved appointment statuses.

BusinessImpact: Inconsistent categories fragment demographic reporting and create duplicate dashboard groups.
RecommendedRemediation: Standardize known variations to approved categories.
